test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a secondary function of commercial banks?
solution:
The correct answer is** Issuing traveller's checks.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Issuing traveller's checks:**

 
 
• This is a secondary function of commercial banks. Traveller's checks are pre-printed, fixed-amount checks designed to allow the person signing them to make an unconditional payment to someone else as a result of having paid the issuer (usually a bank) for that privilege.
 
• They are used primarily by people traveling to foreign countries as a safe and secure way to carry money.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Accepting demand deposits:**

 
 
• This is a primary function of commercial banks. Demand deposits are funds that are deposited in a bank account from which they can be withdrawn at any time without any advance notice.
 
• They are typically used for day-to-day transactions and include checking accounts.
 
 
 
• **Accepting time deposits:**
 
 
• This is another primary function of commercial banks. Time deposits are interest-bearing bank deposits that have a specified date of maturity, such as certificates of deposit (CDs).
 
• Funds deposited in time deposits cannot be withdrawn before the maturity date without incurring a penalty.
 
 
 
• **Advancing loans:**
 
 
• This is also a primary function of commercial banks. Banks provide various types of loans to individuals and businesses, including personal loans, mortgages, and business loans.
 
• These loans are a significant source of income for banks through the interest charged on the borrowed amounts.
